description: Cookbook: at session start, says when a daily update report is waiting (reads ~/.local/share/stack-updates only); at session start, on a prompt and after a tool (at most once per five minutes per session, never for a subagent: a bash gate decides before Node starts), says which model the usage budget asks for (reads the Claude usage at a session start, at most once per ten minutes, and the reading T3 Code saves when that read is refused; writes ~/.local/share/model-budget only); before a T3 tool starts an agent that is not Claude, runs the Codex start check and denies a start it refuses or cannot check (recipes/codex.md); around a question dialog, notes that one was shown and whether it was answered (the chat, the repository and the time, never a question or an answer; writes ~/.local/share/claude-cookbook/owner-answers only), and before one, stops it once to name the other chats of the repository that put questions to the owner; before a T3 tool starts a new chat, stops it once to look at the chats that exist, and before a chat first changes a file of a GitHub repository (found by reading git's own files), stops it once, and again after four hours, to look at those chats and at the files the open pull requests change (recipes/parallel-chats.md); before a Bash or PowerShell call, denies a local test run or Semgrep scan in a repository on sandbox-run's upload list and names the sandbox-run command to use instead, unless the command ends with a `# local-run: <why>` comment (reads git and ~/.local/share/sandbox-run/upload-allowed.txt only; recipes/sandboxes.md), and first, in the same hook, denies a Bash `pkill -f` (or `pgrep -f` feeding `kill`) whose pattern would match its own shell, and an `rm -rf`, naming the next step (reads the command only; recipes/learning-loop.md); at a turn's end, stops once a closing message that leaves an owner question unasked or a finished T3 chat unsettled (recipes/owner-questions.md).
